29:["$","td",null,{"children":["$","$L1c",null,{"href":"/markets/us/g60/requirements/req-g60-us-id-01","className":"title-link","children":"Infotainment & Digital Services"}]}]
3e:T468,this car ticks almost all the boxes for me. the key thing is that it is genuinely fun to drive. on top of that, the purchase price felt competitive and the overall value for a new car seemed good.

the downside is the complexity of the technology. it is not straightforward to learn, and making it simpler would be a very good objective.

the big negative so far has been getting the driver seat adjusted so i do not end up with serious pain in my lower right back and right knee. i spent hours trying to find a position that worked. my son had to set the seat for me again this week, the second time, and now i can drive for about 30 minutes without pain. i am hoping that will also hold up for my regular 2 hour trips. over the last roughly 35 years i have had teslas and e class mercedes and never ran into this problem. my last mercedes had multi contour seats. my i5 has the upgraded seat package, but i just cannot get it dialed in, there are simply too many adjustments. the current e class mercedes offers an electronic assistant to help the driver find a seat position, and maybe bmw should add something like that 70:T468,this car ticks almost all the boxes for me. the key thing is that it is genuinely fun to drive. on top of that, the purchase price felt competitive and the overall value for a new car seemed good.

the downside is the complexity of the technology. it is not straightforward to learn, and making it simpler would be a very good objective.

the big negative so far has been getting the driver seat adjusted so i do not end up with serious pain in my lower right back and right knee. i spent hours trying to find a position that worked. my son had to set the seat for me again this week, the second time, and now i can drive for about 30 minutes without pain. i am hoping that will also hold up for my regular 2 hour trips. over the last roughly 35 years i have had teslas and e class mercedes and never ran into this problem. my last mercedes had multi contour seats. my i5 has the upgraded seat package, but i just cannot get it dialed in, there are simply too many adjustments. the current e class mercedes offers an electronic assistant to help the driver find a seat position, and maybe bmw should add something like that too.63:["$","li","Seat comfort is a real comfort gap, not just a trim preference",{"className":"brief-insight","children":[["$","p",null,{"className":"brief-insight-title","children":"Seat comfort is a real comfort gap, not just a trim preference"}],["$","p",null,{"children":"Seats are the strongest interior complaint theme with 62 complaints, equal to 2.4% of all US complaint rows, and the subsystem has 124 complaints overall. 75:T4e0,Customer stated he is worried about how the range is estimated. Customer stated he drove a 100 mile round trip into the city and back home. Customer stated the car showed roughly 200 miles of range at departure and less than 60 miles remaining once he got back. Customer stated he used efficient mode only for part of the drive home because he began to doubt if there was enough charge to reach his house. Customer stated the average outside temperature was about 32-35 degrees. Customer stated he did not precondition the vehicle before leaving, but the car was kept in his garage overnight. Customer stated the dealership did not clearly explain how to get the best range, and that this is his first electric vehicle.

Writer advised the figure in the instrument cluster is only an estimate. Writer advised that range is affected by climate control usage, driving style, charging behavior, weather, road terrain, and some other variables. Writer advised that preconditioning the vehicle on a cold day will provide a much more accurate range prediction. Writer advised that heating the vehicle up to optimal temperature consumes a lot of battery power, and that not just the cabin but also the battery itself must be warmed to operate efficiently.64:["$","li","Electric range dissatisfaction is partly about absolute range, partly about confidence and winter transparency",{"className":"brief-insight","children":[["$","p",null,{"className":"brief-insight-title","children":"Electric range dissatisfaction is partly about absolute range, partly about confidence and winter transparency"}],["$","p",null,{"children":"Electric Range has 67 complaints, 50 of them usability-related, and dominates the HV battery subsystem, which has 89 complaints versus 45 likes.
